description: StrangeBee Helm charts - Renovate config for the hosted Mend app.

Scope (for now): ONLY the product image tags strangebee/thehive and thehiveproject/cortex, mirrored in appVersion and the artifacthub.io/images annotation of each Chart.yaml. All other managers (subcharts, GitHub Actions) are disabled via enabledManagers.
Each image update also patch-bumps the chart's own version (bumpVersions). Product tags are X.Y.Z-N, so custom regex versioning is used to order the -N revision.

NOTE: Renovate does NOT regenerate helm-docs here (postUpgradeTasks are unavailable on the hosted Mend app), so an image bump leaves the README version/appVersion badges stale and will fail the generate-helm-docs check until docs are regenerated on the PR branch.
Chart-only bumps, non-patch chart versions, subcharts, and CHANGELOG.md entries are handled manually - Renovate does not cover them.

bumpVersions.name: Bump chart version on image updates

packageRules.description: TheHive: scope commits and branches to the chart
